title: Covariant Holographic Entanglement Entropy Inversion to Reconstruct Bulk Geometry
summary: We derive an analytic inverse map from the renormalized covariant interval entropy to a symmetry-reduced stationary bulk metric. The main result applies to stationary homogeneous asymptotically AdS$_3$ geometries with a radial lapse, an independent spatial warp factor, and a stationary shift. On a smooth HRT branch, the interval entropy \(S_{\ren}(Δt,Δx)\) is an on-shell Hamilton--Jacobi functional.
